name: EazyChat
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI chat for websites, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email that answers routine questions around the clock and hands over to your team with the full conversation, with tickets and voice in the same product.
best_for: small businesses that want an AI chat on their website and social channels that answers routine questions around the clock and hands over to a person with the full conversation
skip_if: you have many agents but low chat volume, since per-user pricing adds up, or you need a long-established help desk with a large integration catalogue
honest_knock: Pricing is per user, so a team of five pays five times the plan price. Launch includes only 100 AI conversations a month. The pricing page does not define in its plan text whether the AI quota is per user or per workspace. When we signed up on 18 November 2026 there was no way into the app without first starting a Stripe subscription to a plan called Basic (14 days free, then about $29.99 or €28.45 a month), and that trial ran 14 days, not the 15 the pricing page states. The free trial ends after 15 days or 500 AI interactions, whichever comes first, according to EazyChat's team (email, 6 November 2026). EazyChat is a young product from Smartsoft Solutions LLC with little public track record yet.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Launch · per user per month, 100 AI conversations a month, unlimited human chats, 1 website
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-04 on eazychat.io/pricing.html, US dollars) EazyChat charges per user per month, and every plan includes AI, unlimited human chats and a 15-day free trial, with no long-term contract. Launch costs $29.99 per user a month for 100 AI conversations a month, 1 website with 1 multilingual widget, a website scan, Shopify and API integrations and basic analytics. Pro costs $59.99 per user a month for 1,000 AI conversations, 3 websites and widgets, advanced analytics, AI ticketing and the EazyDesk help desk. Infinity costs $79.99 per user a month for 20,000 AI conversations, unlimited websites and widgets, AI Advisor insights and priority support. If you need more AI capacity in a busy month, add-on packs cost $29 for 1,000, $69 for 5,000 and $129 for 20,000 extra AI conversations. The page does not say whether the AI quota is per user or per workspace, or whether the trial needs a card. EazyChat's team told us by email on 6 November 2026 that the free trial lasts 15 days or 500 AI interactions, whichever comes first; the pricing page does not show the 500 limit. When we signed up on 18 November 2026, the account went straight to a Stripe checkout from SmartSoft Solutions LLC before the app opened: 'Eazychat Basic', 14 days free, then €28.45 a month from 3 December 2026 (the page offered USD as well, at a rate that puts it at about $29.99), '€0.00' due today and a 'Start trial' button stating that subscribing authorises SmartSoft Solutions to charge you. We saw no card field before that button, but starting the trial means starting a subscription, so we stopped there.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested EazyChat in the Launch trial, which ran without a card. A chatbot built from a short text answered a return question from that text and said it could not confirm a question outside it. The trial counter shows 500 AI requests. Cancelling took one dialog, but the first Confirm click gave no feedback. Account and start: we created the account and was signed in; no card or payment method was added. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026 from about 16:00 to 16:20 CET, in its own tab. The interface was in English. The dashboard banner said Your account is in trial mode. Your trial period ends on December 4, 2026. Add a payment method now to avoid losing access when your trial ends. No Stripe screen came before the app this time; the account was already on Launch Eazychat. Core action, a chatbot from a short text: setup has 6 steps: Site, AI profile, Resources, Analysis, Widget and Test. We entered a test shop with no website and a text resource of 274 characters with a return policy, shipping, opening hours and prices. Analysis took about 15 seconds and showed What the AI understood, including Ceramic vases cost €25; table lamps cost €60. Time to the first answer was about 4 minutes. Test 1, inside the source: Can I return an unopened vase after 10 days? The answer: Yes! Your unopened vase is eligible for a full refund if returned within 14 days of delivery, so 10 days is within the return window. Test 2, outside the source: Do you ship to Norway, and do you sell gift cards? The answer: We only ship within the Netherlands, so we can't ship to Norway. I can't confirm whether we sell gift cards. It then offered to connect a person. It did not invent an answer. The widget code was shown but not placed on a site. Teams stayed empty, Reports showed Total Chats 0 and External APIs had none connected. Plans and trial: Plan & Billing shows Launch Eazychat, Number of Agents: 1, Billing Type: monthly, Price per Agent: $29.99, Renewal Date: 12/4/26, Total Price: $0.00, and no payment method. Adding an agent shows New Total Price: $29.99 from the next cycle. AI usage: Total: 500, Used: 3, Remaining: 497. Checkout: no checkout or payment screen was seen in this session. Cancelling, done the same day: Plan & Billing, Cancel subscription, then the dialog Confirm cancellation: This will schedule the cancellation at the end of the current billing cycle. You will keep access until the period ends. You must type subscription before Confirm turns active. The first Confirm click gave no feedback; the second gave Your subscription was canceled. Your service has been canceled, but you will still have access until: Dec 4, 2026. No reason form, no retention offer and no password. Not tested: the widget on a real site, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook, real visitor chats, inviting team members, adding a payment method, upgrading and invoices. Clean up: the account and the test site stay; the subscription is cancelled with access until Dec 4. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first Confirm click in the cancel dialog gave no feedback. The Teams page stayed empty.
